title: Ganesh Chandru moves from Dua Associates to join Kochhar & Co as Senior Partner in Chennai
description: Ganesh Chandru has joined Kochhar & Co as a Senior Partner in Chennai to strengthen the firm's pan-Indian arbitration and litigation capabilities, with a special focus on international arbitration.An alumnus of Madras Law College and the National University of Singapore, Chandru is admitted to practise in India, England & Wales, and Singapore.
